start_checkpoint_rule: AFAC-score primary; D10 fallback only if AFAC unusable
score_convention: s(x) = softmax(logits)[:, 1] (fall class index 1); higher = more fall-like

ranking_loss.definition: H=top-k nonfall by s(x), k=max(1,ceil(0.20*N_nonfall_batch)); L_rank=mean_{i in fall, j in H} max(0, m-(s_i-s_j)); 0 if batch lacks fall or non-fall

full_batch_pgd_statement: D14 uses full-batch PGD adversarial fine-tuning; no 50/50 clean/PGD mixture was used. Both L_PGD_CE and L_rank are computed on the PGD-attacked minibatch. Clean behavior is protected by the clean validation guard.
no_test_read_statement: This training script performed NO held-out test read. Only the training and validation splits were accessed.
